<!doctype html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover"><title>The Lost Landscapes — Recovered Animation Viewer</title>
<style>
:root{color-scheme:dark;--bg:#0c1220;--panel:#151e2e;--text:#eaf1ff;--quiet:#9eb0d0;--accent:#67dbb5;--border:#344560}*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0,#1c3551,var(--bg) 65%);font:15px system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;color:var(--text)}
main{width:min(1150px,96vw);margin:auto;padding:24px 0 34px}header{margin-bottom:18px}h1{font-size:clamp(22px,4vw,32px);margin:5px 0 6px;letter-spacing:-.02em}header p{color:var(--quiet);margin:8px 0;line-height:1.5}.tag{display:inline-block;padding:5px 9px;color:var(--accent);border:1px solid #326b63;border-radius:9px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.04em}
section{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 320px;gap:16px}#stage{width:100%;aspect-ratio:1;max-height:740px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:20px;background:#111c2e;display:block}aside{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.panel{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:15px;padding:15px}.panel h2{font-size:15px;margin:0 0 12px}.panel p{font-size:13px;color:var(--quiet);line-height:1.5}label{display:block;margin:10px 0 5px;color:#b9c6de;font-size:13px;font-weight:600}select,button,input[type=range]{width:100%;font:inherit}select{padding:11px;background:#0c1422;border:1px solid #455671;border-radius:9px;color:#fff}button{background:#25485a;border:1px solid #47748a;border-radius:10px;padding:10px;color:#f4faff;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer}button:hover{background:#346477}button.primary{background:#1e7b62;border-color:#48aa8e}.two{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px}.row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;align-items:center}.muted{color:var(--quiet);font-size:12px}.value{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}input[type=range]{accent-color:var(--accent)}.note{color:#9aaed2;font-size:13px;line-height:1.55}.features{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:12px}.features span{padding:4px 8px;background:#223146;border:1px solid #33455e;border-radius:8px;color:#ccdaeb;font-size:12px}
@media(max-width:800px){section{grid-template-columns:1fr}aside{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}#stage{max-height:none}}@media(max-width:550px){aside{display:flex}main{width:95vw;padding-top:14px}.panel{padding:12px}}
</style></head>
<body><main><header><span class="tag">RECOVERED UNITY + SPINE 3.8</span><h1>🏝️ The Lost Landscapes · Animation Viewer</h1><p>Original art and skeleton keyframes from the leaked development build. Select a monster and an animation to view the recovered motion directly—no game installation required.</p></header>
<section><div><canvas id="stage" width="680" height="680" aria-label="Animated monster stage"></canvas><div class="features"><span>Original textures</span><span>Actual Spine keyframes</span><span>Offline</span><span>Full timelines</span><span>8 monsters</span><span>Mesh opacity repaired</span><span>Costume skins</span></div></div>
<aside><div class="panel"><h2>🎭 Character & animation</h2><label for="monster">Monster</label><select id="monster"></select><label for="animation">Animation</label><select id="animation"></select><div id="skin-panel" hidden><label for="skin-select">Costume / skin</label><select id="skin-select"></select></div><p id="metadata" class="muted"></p></div>
<div class="panel"><h2>⏯️ Playback</h2><div class="two"><button class="primary" id="toggle">Pause</button><button id="restart">Restart</button></div><label for="seek">Timeline</label><input id="seek" type="range" min="0" max="1" step="0.001" value="0"><div class="row"><small id="clock" class="muted value">0.00s / 0.00s</small><small class="muted">Drag to scrub</small></div><label for="speed">Speed <span id="speed-label">1.0×</span></label><input id="speed" type="range" min="0.25" max="2" step="0.05" value="1"><div class="two" style="margin-top:12px"><button id="step">+ 1 frame</button><button id="screenshot">Save frame</button></div></div>
<div class="panel"><h2>🔬 Recovery notes</h2><p>The animations play for their actual recovered keyframe durations, including idle, singing, sleeping, and some experimental sequences.</p><p>This experimental custom viewer supports regions, weighted meshes, deformation, costume skins, and bone transformations. Spine IK, specialized transform inheritance, advanced constraints, event-driven sound, clipping and some easing curves are approximated or not implemented, so results can differ from Unity playback.</p><p>Everything is embedded in this HTML. It doesn't contact a game server or use any third-party JavaScript.</p></div></aside></section></main>
